# taskr

> keep a list of tasks

Taskr keeps a list of tasks in a file and syncs it with a server.

## Commands

- [taskr add](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-add.md): add a task
- [taskr list](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-list.md): list tasks
- [taskr purge](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-purge.md): delete finished tasks
- [taskr import](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-import.md): add tasks read from stdin
- [taskr remote sync](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-remote-sync.md): sync with the server
- [taskr remote show](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-remote-show.md): show the server's address
- [taskr remote login](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-remote-login.md): log in with a key file

## Optional

- [taskr](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr.md): keep a list of tasks
- [taskr remote](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-remote.md): work with the server
- [taskr exec](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-exec.md): run a command with the list's directory
- [taskr old](https://taskr.example.com/cli/taskr-old.md): an old way to list (deprecated: use list)
